about_the_game:
Fall fast. Get up faster.

Doorway 2 is a high-speed parkour platformer built for momentum, precision, and competition. Jump, slide, and crawl through chaotic, ever-changing obstacle rooms in a surreal world. Run solo or compete with others in multiplayer—every second counts.

Miss a jump? No sweat. You’ll respawn at the start of the last room you entered. No full resets, just fast retries that keep you in the flow.

With unique boss arenas, time-based challenges, and movement-focused design, Doorway 2 is all about pushing your limits without ever hitting pause.

Features:

Parkour-Driven Movement – Leap gaps, slide under hazards, and crawl through tight spots in tightly designed obstacle maps.

Room-Based Respawns – Fall, fail, restart in the previous room and keep your run going. No full resets.

Single and Multiplayer Modes – Run solo or race your friends online for the best time.

Distinct Boss Encounters – Avoid deadly bosses that disrupt movement mid-run, each tied to unique map mechanics.

Speed-Focused Design – Timer-based gameplay and online leaderboards challenge you to master every corner.

Stylized Worlds – Dive into a series of surreal, atmospheric environments, each with its own visual identity and flow.
